rationale: David brings deep production robotics expertise (autonomous drones at Skycatch, tractors at Agtonomy) and is now building real-time infrastructure at LiveKit specifically for autonomous systems, while Sharon is building production-ready AI agent infrastructure at TheAgentic.Ai across biotech, healthtech, and fintech. Their complementary skill sets—David's end-to-end robotics systems knowledge and real-time comms focus paired with Sharon's AI agent infrastructure experience—could surface interesting intersections around autonomous agents in physical domains.
intro_message: David Chen, meet Sharon — you're both architecting production infrastructure for next-gen autonomous systems (robotics + AI agents), and your experiences shipping at scale in different domains could spark useful conversation.
